original_goal:
[Module: Open New Account | TC-011 | Type: Negative | Priority: High]
Title: Funding account has insufficient balance for requested deposit

▶ Start URL:    http://localhost:8080/open-new-account
▶ Requires Auth: Yes
▶ Test Data:
{
  "account_type": "Checking",
  "initial_deposit": "6000",
  "funding_account": "****5001 (Checking)",
  "funding_account_balance": "5847.52",
  "user_email": "admin@parabank.com",
  "username": "admin"
}

Preconditions:
  User is on the Open New Account page and logged in as 'admin' (admin@parabank.com). A funding account exists (Checking ****5001 with $5,847.52).

Steps to Execute:
  1. Select 'Checking' as Account Type
  2. Enter '6000' in Initial Deposit Amount (amount exceeding the selected funding account balance)
  3. Select the under-funded account '****5001 (Checking, $5,847.52)' from the Funding Source dropdown
  4. Click 'Open Account'

Expected Result:
  Funding Source Account dropdown shows inline error about insufficient balance; form does not submit; no account is created

Notes from prior verification:
  Selected an amount (6000) that exceeds the seeded Checking account balance ($5,847.52) to trigger the insufficient-funds path. All steps reference concrete seeded data.
expected_outcome: Funding Source Account dropdown shows inline error about insufficient balance; form does not submit; no account is created
